description: Draft thoughtful replies for personal and relationship conversations.

defaultPrompt: Help me write a kind but clear reply to this message.
I want to set a boundary without sounding harsh. Draft a few options.
Help me understand this conversation without assuming what they meant.
interface.longDescription: Help users understand a conversation, choose a response goal, and draft thoughtful replies for personal relationships, family, friendship, dating, and everyday conflict. Offer tone options while preserving the user's voice and boundaries. Encourage honest, respectful communication—not pressure, deception, surveillance, or guaranteed relationship outcomes.

name: relationship-reply-coach
